titles.de: Gesetz über das Kreditwesen (Kreditwesengesetz - KWG)
titles.en: Banking Act

payload.officialRef: Kreditwesengesetz in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 9. September 1998 (BGBl. I S. 2776)
payload.implementsNote: CRD6, Directive (EU) 2024/1619; EMIR 3 Directive, Directive (EU) 2024/2994; and the earlier Directives 2009/27/EC, 2009/44/EC, 2009/83/EC and 2009/111/EC (the directives the act's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a proper business organisation with effective risk management
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25a Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep a proper business organisation with effective risk management

summaries.en: An institution must have a business organisation that ensures compliance with the law, for which its managing directors are responsible. It includes sound governance and risk management that keeps risk-bearing capacity at all times: business and risk strategies reviewed at least every two years, an internal control system with independent risk control and compliance functions, a separate internal audit, adequate staff, technology and data management, contingency plans, in particular for IT systems, and sustainable remuneration systems. The institution must review the adequacy and effectiveness of its risk management regularly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give employees a confidential process for reporting breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25a Abs. 1 Satz 6 Nr. 3

titles.en: Give employees a confidential process for reporting breaches

summaries.en: An institution must have a process that lets employees report, with their identity kept confidential, breaches of the CRR, the Market Abuse Regulation, MiFIR, the PRIIPs Regulation, the Prospectus Regulation, the Banking Act, the Securities Trading Act and the regulations under them, and any criminal acts within the firm, to suitable bodies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document the business completely and keep the records for at least five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25a Abs. 1 Satz 6 Nr. 2

titles.en: Document the business completely and keep the records for at least five years

summaries.en: An institution must document its business completely so that BaFin can supervise it without gaps, and must keep the records this requires for at least five years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cap variable pay at 100 per cent of fixed pay unless the owners approve up to 200 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25a Abs. 5

titles.en: Cap variable pay at 100 per cent of fixed pay unless the owners approve up to 200 per cent

summaries.en: An institution must set appropriate ratios between variable and fixed annual remuneration and keep each employee's and managing director's variable pay at no more than 100 per cent of fixed pay. The shareholders, owners, members or public owners may approve a higher cap of up to 200 per cent, on a reasoned proposal and with at least 66 per cent of the votes cast where half the voting rights are represented, or 75 per cent otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control outsourcing and keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25b Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Control outsourcing and keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements

summaries.en: When an institution outsources activities or processes that are material to its banking business or financial services, it must take precautions against excessive additional risk, keep its risk management covering them, and enter every material and non-material outsourcing in an outsourcing register. Responsibility stays with the managing directors and the institution, and BaFin's and the auditors' rights to information and inspection must be secured. Each outsourcing needs a written agreement with the institution's rights to instruct and terminate, and a material provider in a third country must name an agent in Germany for service of documents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint managing directors who are qualified, reliable and have enough time
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 25c Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Appoint managing directors who are qualified, reliable and have enough time

summaries.en: The managing directors of an institution must be professionally qualified and reliable and devote enough time to the role; qualification requires theoretical and practical knowledge of the business and management experience. At a significant institution a managing director may not also sit on that institution's supervisory body, be a managing director elsewhere or hold more than two supervisory mandates, with mandates inside one group counted as one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the supervisors without delay of changes in management, ownership, capital and outsourcing
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 24 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify the supervisors without delay of changes in management, ownership, capital and outsourcing

summaries.en: An institution must notify without delay, among other events, the intended appointment and the departure of a managing director, the appointment and departure of members of the supervisory body, a change of legal form, name or seat, a loss of 5 per cent of Common Equity Tier 1 capital, changes in qualifying holdings in the institution and in its own significant holdings and close links, the intention to outsource a material activity, and the end of business. At a large undertaking within the meaning of § 1 Abs. 1c the intended appointment of a managing director is notified at least 30 working days before the person takes up the role.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have borrowers of large loans disclose their financial circumstances
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 18

titles.en: Have borrowers of large loans disclose their financial circumstances

summaries.en: A credit institution may grant a loan that in total exceeds 1,500,000 euros or 10 per cent of its Tier 1 capital only if it has the borrower disclose their financial circumstances, in particular by presenting annual accounts. It may waive this where the request would be plainly unfounded given the collateral or the co-obligors, and the section lists loans, such as certain owner-occupied home loans and loans to public bodies with a zero risk weight, for which ongoing or any disclosure is not needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Check a consumer's creditworthiness before concluding a loan agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 18a Abs. 1 und 4

titles.en: Check a consumer's creditworthiness before concluding a loan agreement

summaries.en: A credit institution must assess the borrower's creditworthiness before concluding a consumer loan agreement, and may conclude it only if there are no substantial doubts about creditworthiness for a general consumer loan, or it is likely that the borrower will meet the obligations for a residential property loan. For a residential property loan the assessment rests on necessary, sufficient and appropriate information on income, expenses and other circumstances, and may not rely mainly on the value of the property exceeding the loan or on an expected rise in that value, unless the loan serves to build or renovate the property.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant loans to managers, board members and related parties only by unanimous decision and on market terms
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 15 Abs. 1

titles.en: Grant loans to managers, board members and related parties only by unanimous decision and on market terms

summaries.en: Loans to the institution's managing directors, members of its supervisory body, holders of general commercial authority, their spouses, partners, children and parents, and the related companies and shareholders the section lists may be granted only by a unanimous decision of all managing directors, on market terms outside staff programmes, and with the express consent of the supervisory body. Managing directors and supervisory board members with a conflict of interest may take no part in the decision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report borrowers owing one million euros or more to the Bundesbank every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 14 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report borrowers owing one million euros or more to the Bundesbank every quarter

summaries.en: Credit institutions and the other firms taking part in the large-loan reporting procedure must report each quarter, to the credit register kept at the Deutsche Bundesbank, the borrowers whose credit volume is one million euros or more. A parent undertaking reports for the group companies that do not report themselves.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the account file that BaFin can query automatically at any time
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 24c Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep the account file that BaFin can query automatically at any time

summaries.en: A credit institution must keep a file that stores without delay the number, opening date and closing date of every account subject to identity verification under § 154 of the Fiscal Code, every securities account and every safe deposit box, with the name, address and date of birth of the holder and of anyone authorised to dispose, and the name of a different beneficial owner. It must ensure BaFin can retrieve the data automatically at any time without the institution learning of the retrieval, and delete the data ten years after the account is closed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell customers which protection scheme covers them and give depositors the information sheet
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditwesengesetz (KWG), BGBl. I S. 2776, § 23a Abs. 1

titles.en: Tell customers which protection scheme covers them and give depositors the information sheet

summaries.en: An institution that takes deposits or provides the listed investment services must tell customers that are not institutions, in its price display, which protection scheme it belongs to, and before the business relationship starts must inform them in text form and plain terms of the rules on protection, its scope and its amount. Depositors confirm receipt on the information sheet in Annex I, find the confirmation that their deposits are eligible on their account statements, and are given the sheet at least once a year.

instruments.title: Add PfandBG, the German covered bond act (Pfandbriefgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 23 G v. 25.3.2026 I Nr. 81); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 20 G v. 22.5.2005 I 1373)

titles.de: Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG)
titles.en: Pfandbrief Act (covered bonds)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep outstanding Pfandbriefe covered at all times with an excess of 2 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Keep outstanding Pfandbriefe covered at all times with an excess of 2 per cent

summaries.en: A Pfandbrief bank must ensure that its outstanding Pfandbriefe are covered at all times by present value, including interest and repayment obligations, and that the present value of the registered cover assets exceeds the liabilities to be covered by 2 per cent, held in the liquid assets the section lists. The Pfandbriefe of each class must also be covered at all times by nominal value through the cover assets registered for that class.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cover the largest liquidity gap of the next 180 days with liquid cover assets
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 4 Abs. 1a

titles.en: Cover the largest liquidity gap of the next 180 days with liquid cover assets

summaries.en: To secure liquidity, a Pfandbrief bank must compare day by day, for the next 180 days, the claims falling due from registered cover assets with the liabilities falling due from outstanding Pfandbriefe and derivatives in cover, and add up the daily differences. The largest negative cumulative amount in that period must be covered at all times by registered cover assets that qualify as liquid assets under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/61 and by the short-term bank balances the section allows.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Enter every cover asset individually in the cover register
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 5 Abs. 1

titles.en: Enter every cover asset individually in the cover register

summaries.en: A Pfandbrief bank must enter each asset used to cover Pfandbriefe and claims under cover derivatives individually in the cover register kept for the Pfandbrief class. Derivatives may be entered only with the consent of the cover pool monitor and the counterparty, and when a needed cover asset is repaid or stops being eligible, replacement assets must be entered without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use mortgages as cover only up to 60 per cent of the mortgage lending value
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 14

titles.en: Use mortgages as cover only up to 60 per cent of the mortgage lending value

summaries.en: Mortgages may be used as cover only up to the first 60 per cent of the property's mortgage lending value, which the Pfandbrief bank sets on the basis of a valuation under § 16.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the mortgage lending value set prudently by a valuer independent of the credit decision
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 16 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Have the mortgage lending value set prudently by a valuer independent of the credit decision

summaries.en: The valuation on which the mortgage lending value rests must be made by a valuer who is independent of the credit decision and has the necessary professional experience and expertise. The value may not exceed what a prudent assessment of the property's future saleability gives, taking its long-term sustainable features and normal regional market conditions into account without speculative elements, and may not exceed a market value determined transparently by a recognised method.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a documented risk management system for the Pfandbrief business
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 27

titles.en: Run a documented risk management system for the Pfandbrief business

summaries.en: A Pfandbrief bank must have a suitable risk management system for its Pfandbrief business that identifies, assesses, controls and monitors all related risks, limits concentrations through a limit system, is reviewed at least once a year and produces a risk report for the management board at least every quarter, and must document the system in detail. Before starting business in new products, business types or markets it must analyse and document the risks, and may take such assets into cover only once it has well-founded experience, for mortgage lending in new markets not before two years have passed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish cover pool data for each Pfandbrief class on the website every quarter
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbriefgesetz (PfandBG), BGBl. I S. 1373, § 28 Abs. 1

titles.en: Publish cover pool data for each Pfandbrief class on the website every quarter

summaries.en: A Pfandbrief bank must publish on its website each quarter, as at the end of the quarter and separately for each class of Pfandbrief it has outstanding, the data the section lists, including the total amount of Pfandbriefe and of the cover pools by nominal value, present value and stressed present value, the list of ISINs, the amount of excess cover, and the maturity structure of the Pfandbriefe and the fixed-interest periods of the cover pools.

titles.de: Gesetz zur Sanierung und Abwicklung von Instituten und Finanzgruppen (Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz - SAG)
titles.en: Act on the Recovery and Resolution of Institutions and Financial Groups (Recovery and Resolution Act)

payload.officialRef: Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz vom 10. Dezember 2014 (BGBl. I S. 2091)
payload.implementsNote: Covered Bond Directive, Directive (EU) 2019/2162; Directive (EU) 2024/1174; Directive (EU) 2023/2864 (the directives the act's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up a recovery plan, submit it and update it at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 12 Abs. 1, 3 und 4

titles.en: Draw up a recovery plan, submit it and update it at least once a year

summaries.en: An institution that is not exempted must draw up a recovery plan setting out the measures by which it can secure or restore its financial stability if its position deteriorates so that its existence could be threatened; in a group only the parent draws up a plan for the whole group. It submits the plan to the supervisory authority and the Deutsche Bundesbank within the period the authority sets, which may not exceed six months. It must update and resubmit the plan after every change that could materially affect it and at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Support the resolution authority in drawing up and updating the resolution plan
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 42 Abs. 1

titles.en: Support the resolution authority in drawing up and updating the resolution plan

summaries.en: When the resolution authority requires, an institution must support it fully in drawing up and updating the resolution plan, in particular by sending all information and analyses needed to prepare and carry out the plan. The authority may also impose notification and reporting duties needed for the plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep all financial contracts centrally and retrievable at short notice when required
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 43 Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep all financial contracts centrally and retrievable at short notice when required

summaries.en: When the supervisory or the resolution authority requires, institutions, group companies and the parent for the whole group must keep all financial contracts centrally and manage them properly, so that contracts can be found and reviewed quickly and are classified by their importance with their main terms recorded. They must keep a system that allows the contracts held to be evaluated at short notice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities set by the resolution authority
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 49 Abs. 1

titles.en: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities set by the resolution authority

summaries.en: Institutions and group companies must comply, when the resolution authority requires it, with the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities as it follows from § 49 Abs. 2 and §§ 49a to 51.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Write a bail-in recognition clause into liabilities governed by third-country law
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 55 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Write a bail-in recognition clause into liabilities governed by third-country law

summaries.en: Institutions and group companies must agree, in the terms of liabilities governed by the law of a third country, that the creditor recognises that the bail-in tool may be applied to the liability and accepts a full or partial write-down of the principal or outstanding amount and a conversion into shares or other Common Equity Tier 1 instruments by the resolution authority. A missing clause does not stop the authority from applying the tool. On request they must give the resolution authority a legal opinion on the enforceability and validity of the clause.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Write a clause recognising resolution stays into financial contracts under third-country law
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 60a Abs. 1

titles.en: Write a clause recognising resolution stays into financial contracts under third-country law

summaries.en: Institutions and group companies must include in financial contracts governed by the law of a third country a term by which the counterparty recognises that the powers to suspend termination rights and other contractual rights temporarily may be applied, and accepts a suspension ordered under those powers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the supervisory and the resolution authority at once when the institution's existence is threatened
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanierungs- und Abwicklungsgesetz (SAG), BGBl. I S. 2091, § 138 Abs. 1

titles.en: Tell the supervisory and the resolution authority at once when the institution's existence is threatened

summaries.en: Where the existence of an institution or a group company is threatened within the meaning of § 63, the management of the institution or of the group's parent, and of the threatened group company, must inform the supervisory authority and the resolution authority without delay.

instruments.title: Add EinSiG, the German Deposit Guarantee Act (Einlagensicherungsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 26 Abs. 5 G v. 25.3.2026 I Nr. 81); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 9 Abs. 1 G v. 28.5.2015 I 786)

titles.de: Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG)
titles.en: Deposit Guarantee Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect deposits by belonging to a deposit guarantee scheme
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, § 1

titles.en: Protect deposits by belonging to a deposit guarantee scheme

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution must protect its deposits by belonging to a deposit guarantee scheme under this Act. German branches of firms based abroad that take deposits and grant credit count as CRR credit institutions for this purpose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Mark eligible deposits so each depositor's total can be produced at once in machine-readable form
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, § 7 Abs. 8

titles.en: Mark eligible deposits so each depositor's total can be produced at once in machine-readable form

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution must give the deposit guarantee scheme, on request and at any time, all information the scheme needs to prepare a payout, including each depositor's total eligible deposits. Eligible deposits must be marked so that they can be determined immediately for each depositor, and the data needed to compensate creditors must be supplied in machine-processable form as the scheme specifies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay annual contributions to the statutory compensation scheme
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, § 26

titles.en: Pay annual contributions to the statutory compensation scheme

summaries.en: Until the scheme reaches its target level, a CRR credit institution must pay contributions each year, at the end of the accounting year running from 1 October to 30 September, to the statutory compensation scheme it is assigned to. An institution assigned to a statutory scheme after 1 August 1998 also makes a one-off payment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the compensation scheme the audited annual accounts and report material changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, § 34

titles.en: Send the compensation scheme the audited annual accounts and report material changes

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution must submit its adopted annual accounts with the audit report to its statutory compensation scheme without delay and, on request, give all information and documents the scheme needs. It must also inform the scheme of every material change in its business model or other circumstances that could materially increase covered deposits or create or raise the risk of a compensation case.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to the compensation scheme on how audit deficiencies are being remedied when asked
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Einlagensicherungsgesetz (EinSiG), BGBl. I S. 786, § 39 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report to the compensation scheme on how audit deficiencies are being remedied when asked

summaries.en: Where an audit by the statutory compensation scheme finds a deficiency in the institution's legal, organisational or economic circumstances that could raise the risk of a compensation case, the scheme may require the institution to report on the measures planned to remedy it and on their implementation.

instruments.title: Add DepotG, the German Safe Custody Act (Depotgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 24 G v. 23.10.2024 I Nr. 323); the page states no entry into force

titles.de: Gesetz über die Verwahrung und Anschaffung von Wertpapieren (Depotgesetz - DepotG)
titles.en: Act on the Safe Custody and Acquisition of Securities (Safe Custody Act)

payload.officialRef: Depotgesetz in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 11. Januar 1995 (BGBl. I S. 34)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep each depositor's securities separately unless collective custody applies
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 2

titles.en: Keep each depositor's securities separately unless collective custody applies

summaries.en: A custodian must keep securities separately from its own holdings and from those of third parties, under a visible designation of each depositor, where the securities are not admitted to collective custody at a central securities depository or the depositor asks for separate custody.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer for the sub-custodian and choose it with care
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 3 Abs. 2

titles.en: Answer for the sub-custodian and choose it with care

summaries.en: A custodian that has securities kept by another custodian is liable for that custodian's fault as for its own. It stays responsible for careful selection of the sub-custodian even where liability for the sub-custodian's fault was waived by contract, unless the securities are held with a particular sub-custodian on the depositor's express instruction.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold securities in own or third-party collective custody only on an express authorisation
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 5 Abs. 1

titles.en: Hold securities in own or third-party collective custody only on an express authorisation

summaries.en: A custodian may place fungible securities admitted to collective custody with a central securities depository unless the depositor asked for separate custody. Keeping them unsegregated itself or entrusting them to another third party for collective custody requires the depositor's express authorisation in text form, given for each custody transaction and neither contained in the custodian's terms of business nor referring to other documents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pledge a depositor's securities only on an express authorisation and only for the depositor's credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 12 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Pledge a depositor's securities only on an express authorisation and only for the depositor's credit

summaries.en: A custodian may pledge securities or shares in a collective holding only on an authorisation, only in connection with credit granted to the depositor and only to another custodian. The authorisation must be given expressly and in text form for the single custody transaction and may not sit in the terms of business, and the custodian may refinance against the securities only up to the total credit it has granted its depositors.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take ownership of client securities only on a separate express declaration
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 13 Abs. 1

titles.en: Take ownership of client securities only on a separate express declaration

summaries.en: A declaration that authorises the custodian to appropriate the securities or transfer ownership to a third party, leaving it obliged only to return securities of the same kind, must be made expressly and in text form for the single custody transaction. It must state that ownership passes and that the depositor then holds only a contractual claim to delivery, and may neither refer to other documents nor be combined with other declarations of the depositor.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a custody ledger of every depositor and the securities held for them
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 14

titles.en: Keep a custody ledger of every depositor and the securities held for them

summaries.en: A custodian must keep a ledger in which each depositor and the kind, nominal amount or number and the numbers or other identifying features of the securities held for them are entered, for collective custody as well. Where securities are entrusted to a third party the ledger shows the place of that party's establishment, and it shows any authorisation for collective custody under § 5 Abs. 1 Satz 2, exchange custody, pledging or disposal of ownership.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the client a list of the securities bought on commission within a week
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Depotgesetz (DepotG), BGBl. I S. 34, § 18 Abs. 1

titles.en: Send the client a list of the securities bought on commission within a week

summaries.en: A commission agent that carries out an order to buy securities must send the client a list of the securities bought without delay and within one week at the latest, identifying them by class, nominal amount and numbers or other identifying features.

instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 15 G v. 9.4.2026 I Nr. 97); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 9 Abs. 4 G v. 11.4.2016 I 720)

titles.de: Gesetz über die Vergleichbarkeit von Zahlungskontoentgelten, den Wechsel von Zahlungskonten sowie den Zugang zu Zahlungskonten mit grundlegenden Funktionen (Zahlungskontengesetz - ZKG)
titles.en: Act on the Comparability of Payment Account Fees, Payment Account Switching and Access to Payment Accounts with Basic Features (Payment Accounts Act)

payload.officialRef: Zahlungskontengesetz vom 11. April 2016 (BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a consumer the fee information document before the payment account contract
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 5

titles.en: Give a consumer the fee information document before the payment account contract

summaries.en: A payment service provider must give a consumer, free of charge and in good time before the consumer commits to a framework contract for a payment account, the information on fees for the services linked to the account (the fee information document) in the content and form §§ 6 to 9 prescribe.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give each consumer a statement of fees at least once a year and when the account ends
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 10

titles.en: Give each consumer a statement of fees at least once a year and when the account ends

summaries.en: A payment service provider must give a consumer with a payment account, free of charge, a statement of all fees incurred for the services linked to the account and, where relevant, of the overdraft interest rate and the credit interest rate. The statement is provided at least once a year during the contract and when the contract ends.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep fee, basic account and switching information easily accessible to consumers
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 14 Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep fee, basic account and switching information easily accessible to consumers

summaries.en: A payment service provider that publicly offers payment accounts to consumers must keep available to them at all times, free of charge, in text form and easy to reach, the fee information for the accounts it offers, information on the features, fees, costs and terms of use of its basic accounts, a notice that access to a basic account may not be tied to further conditions or services, and information on the account switching service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report payment account fees and conditions to BaFin for the comparison website
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 17 Abs. 2

titles.en: Report payment account fees and conditions to BaFin for the comparison website

summaries.en: Payment service providers must report to BaFin the data on the criteria the comparison website compares: the fees for the relevant payment account services with any costs and penalties, the branch network, the cash machine network and the borrowing rates for agreed and tolerated overdrafts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide the account switching service when a consumer asks for it
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 20

titles.en: Provide the account switching service when a consumer asks for it

summaries.en: When a consumer wants to switch from a payment account at one provider to an account at another, both providers must give the switching service on request, once the consumer and any other account holder has given the authorisation § 21 requires. The duty does not apply where one of the providers is not established in Germany or the two accounts are not kept in the same currency.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Complete the receiving provider's switching tasks within five business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 24 Abs. 1

titles.en: Complete the receiving provider's switching tasks within five business days

summaries.en: Within five business days of receiving the lists and information from the transferring provider, the receiving provider must, as far as the authorisation provides, set up the standing orders the consumer wants, make the arrangements to accept direct debits, and give the payers and direct debit creditors named in the authorisation the consumer's new account details.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open a basic payment account for every eligible consumer within ten business days
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 31

titles.en: Open a basic payment account for every eligible consumer within ten business days

summaries.en: An institution that offers payment accounts to consumers must conclude a basic account contract with every eligible person whose application meets § 33: any consumer lawfully resident in the European Union, including people with no fixed address, asylum seekers and people without a residence permit who cannot be deported. It must confirm receipt of the application with a copy and offer the contract without delay and within ten business days of receiving it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse a basic account only on the statutory grounds and explain the refusal in writing
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 34 Abs. 1, 3 und 4

titles.en: Refuse a basic account only on the statutory grounds and explain the refusal in writing

summaries.en: An institution may refuse an application for a basic account that meets the requirements only on the grounds set out in §§ 35 to 37. With the refusal it must tell the applicant, free of charge and in text form, the reasons, unless that would endanger public security such as the rules against money laundering or breach a ban on passing on information, and must explain the administrative procedure under § 48 and the right to go to the consumer conciliation body, with that body's contact details.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Charge only reasonable fees for a basic account and agree no contractual penalties
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungskontengesetz (ZKG), BGBl. I S. 720; 2018 I S. 668, § 41 Abs. 2 und 3

titles.en: Charge only reasonable fees for a basic account and agree no contractual penalties

summaries.en: The fee for the services a basic account must include has to be reasonable, judged in particular by the fees usual in the market and by how the account is used; the same holds for costs the account holder is to reimburse. An agreement that the account holder owes a contractual penalty in connection with the basic account is not allowed.

instruments.title: Add BGB, the German Civil Code, for its consumer credit and payment services rules
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 6 G v. 23.7.2026 I Nr. 226); entry into force read in Art 1 Abs. 1 of the Einführungsgesetz zum Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuche

titles.de: Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB)
titles.en: Civil Code

payload.officialRef: Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 2. Januar 2002 (BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a consumer the pre-contract information and adequate explanations before a loan agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 491a Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: Give a consumer the pre-contract information and adequate explanations before a loan agreement

summaries.en: A lender must give the borrower the pre-contract information set out in Article 247 of the Introductory Act to the Civil Code. Before a consumer loan agreement is concluded it must also give adequate explanations so that the borrower can judge whether the contract suits their purpose and financial situation, covering where needed the pre-contract information, the main features of the contracts offered and their typical effects, including the consequences of late payment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Conclude consumer loan agreements in writing with the required content and hand over a copy
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 492 Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Conclude consumer loan agreements in writing with the required content and hand over a copy

summaries.en: A consumer loan agreement must be concluded in writing unless a stricter form applies and must contain the details Article 247 §§ 6 to 13 of the Introductory Act prescribes. After conclusion the lender gives the borrower a copy of the contract, and where a repayment date is set the borrower can ask for a repayment plan at any time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the borrower before a fixed rate ends and before a variable rate changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 493 Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: Tell the borrower before a fixed rate ends and before a variable rate changes

summaries.en: Where a fixed borrowing rate ends before the loan is due for repayment, the lender must tell the borrower at least three months before the end of the fixed period whether it is willing to agree a new fixed rate, and state the rate it then offers. A change to a variable borrowing rate takes effect only after the lender has informed the borrower of the details Article 247 § 15 of the Introductory Act requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness before concluding a loan agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 505a Abs. 1

titles.en: Assess the consumer's creditworthiness before concluding a loan agreement

summaries.en: A lender must assess the borrower's creditworthiness before concluding a consumer loan agreement. It may conclude the agreement only if the assessment shows no substantial doubts for a general consumer loan, or that the borrower is likely to meet the obligations under the contract for a residential property loan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base advice on residential property loans on the borrower's situation and a sufficient range of loans
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 511 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Base advice on residential property loans on the borrower's situation and a sufficient range of loans

summaries.en: Before giving a borrower individual recommendations on a residential property loan, a lender must give the information Article 247 § 18 of the Introductory Act requires. It must find out the borrower's needs, personal and financial situation, preferences and objectives and, on that basis and on realistic assumptions about the risks over the term, examine a sufficient number of loan agreements, at least from its own product range, for their suitability.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give payment service users the information the Introductory Act prescribes
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 675d Abs. 1

titles.en: Give payment service users the information the Introductory Act prescribes

summaries.en: A payment service provider must inform payment service users, when providing payment services, of the matters set out in Article 248 §§ 1 to 12, § 13 Abs. 1 and 3 to 5 and §§ 14 to 16 of the Introductory Act to the Civil Code, in the form prescribed there.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer changes to a payment services framework contract at least two months ahead
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 675g Abs. 1

titles.en: Offer changes to a payment services framework contract at least two months ahead

summaries.en: A change to a payment services framework contract proposed by the provider requires that the provider offers the intended change to the user, in the form Article 248 §§ 2 and 3 of the Introductory Act prescribes, no later than two months before the date proposed for it to take effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect payment instruments and let users report loss or misuse at any time, free of charge
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 675m Abs. 1

titles.en: Protect payment instruments and let users report loss or misuse at any time, free of charge

summaries.en: A payment service provider that issues a payment instrument must ensure that its personalised security credentials are accessible only to the person entitled to use it, send no unsolicited instruments except replacements, give the user suitable means to report loss, theft or misuse at any time and free of charge, and prevent any use of the instrument once such a report is made. On request it gives the user, for at least 18 months after the report, the means to prove that the report was made.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deliver a payment to the payee's provider by the end of the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 675s Abs. 1

titles.en: Deliver a payment to the payee's provider by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: The payer's payment service provider must ensure that the amount reaches the payee's payment service provider by the end of the business day following receipt of the payment order. For payments within the European Economic Area that are not in euro a period of up to four business days may be agreed, and for paper-initiated payments the period may be extended by one further business day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB), BGBl. I S. 42, 2909; 2003 I S. 738, § 675u

titles.en: Refund an unauthorised payment by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: For an unauthorised payment transaction the payer's payment service provider has no claim against the payer and must refund the amount without delay, restoring a debited payment account to the state it would have been in, at the latest by the end of the business day after it was notified or otherwise learned that the payment was unauthorised. Where it has told a competent authority in writing of justified grounds to suspect fraud by the payer, it must examine and meet the duty without delay once the suspicion is not confirmed, and where a payment initiation service provider was used the duties fall on the account servicing provider.

instruments.title: Add WpHG, the German Securities Trading Act (Wertpapierhandelsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 11 G v. 26.5.2026 I Nr. 156); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 20 G v. 26.7.1994 I 1749)

titles.de: Gesetz über den Wertpapierhandel (Wertpapierhandelsgesetz - WpHG)
titles.en: Securities Trading Act

payload.officialRef: Wertpapierhandelsgesetz in der Fassung der Bekanntmachung vom 9. September 1998 (BGBl. I S. 2708)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide investment services honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 63 Abs. 1

titles.en: Provide investment services honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interests

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise must provide investment services and ancillary services honestly, fairly and professionally in the best interests of its clients.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not pay or assess staff in a way that conflicts with clients' interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 63 Abs. 3

titles.en: Do not pay or assess staff in a way that conflicts with clients' interests

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise must ensure that it does not remunerate or assess its staff in a way that conflicts with its duty to act in clients' best interests. In particular it may not, through pay arrangements, sales targets or otherwise, give staff an incentive to recommend a particular financial instrument to a retail client when another one it could offer would meet the client's needs better.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Recommend or trade only what is suitable for the client
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 64 Abs. 3

titles.en: Recommend or trade only what is suitable for the client

summaries.en: For investment advice and portfolio management the firm must obtain from the client all information on knowledge and experience, financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance that it needs to recommend a suitable instrument or service. It may recommend, or trade within portfolio management, only what is suitable on that information, and where a switch of instruments is involved it must analyse the costs and benefits of the switch.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a retail client a suitability statement before the contract is concluded
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 64 Abs. 4

titles.en: Give a retail client a suitability statement before the contract is concluded

summaries.en: A firm giving investment advice must provide the retail client, on a durable medium and before the contract is concluded, with a statement on the suitability of the recommendation that names the advice given and explains how it was matched to the client's preferences, investment objectives and other characteristics. Where the transaction is agreed by a means of distance communication that does not allow this, the statement may be provided immediately afterwards if the client agreed to that and the firm offered to delay the transaction so that the client could receive it first.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept or pay third-party inducements only if they improve the service and are disclosed
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 70 Abs. 1

titles.en: Accept or pay third-party inducements only if they improve the service and are disclosed

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise may not accept inducements from, or grant them to, third parties in connection with its services unless the inducement is designed to enhance the quality of the service for the client, does not impair acting in the client's best interests, and its existence, nature and amount or method of calculation are disclosed to the client clearly, accurately and comprehensibly before the service is provided. The firm must be able to prove that every inducement serves to enhance quality, must later tell the client the exact amount where only the method of calculation was disclosed, and must inform clients individually at least once a year of the actual amounts for as long as it receives ongoing inducements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the firm to keep services running and to prevent or manage conflicts of interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 80 Abs. 1

titles.en: Organise the firm to keep services running and to prevent or manage conflicts of interest

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise must meet the organisational duties of the Banking Act or the Investment Firms Act and, beyond them, take adequate precautions for the continuity and regularity of its services, using suitable systems including its ICT systems under DORA. It must keep effective arrangements to identify and prevent or manage conflicts of interest between itself, its staff and tied agents and its clients, or among clients, including those arising from inducements and its own pay structure, and must design and monitor sales targets so that client interests are not harmed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product approval process with a defined target market before selling a financial instrument
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 80 Abs. 9

titles.en: Run a product approval process with a defined target market before selling a financial instrument

summaries.en: A firm that designs financial instruments for sale must maintain, operate and review a process for approving each instrument and each significant change to an existing one before it is marketed or distributed to clients. The process must define a target market of end clients for each instrument, assess all risks relevant to that market and ensure the intended distribution strategy fits it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set an order execution policy and execute every client order under it for the best result
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 82 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Set an order execution policy and execute every client order under it for the best result

summaries.en: A firm that executes client orders to buy or sell financial instruments must take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result for its clients, in particular by setting an order execution policy and reviewing it regularly, and must ensure every order is executed under that policy. The policy weighs price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, and the size and nature of the order against the characteristics of the client, the order, the instrument and the execution venue.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep records of services and transactions and record order-related calls and messages for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 83 Abs. 1, 3 und 8

titles.en: Keep records of services and transactions and record order-related calls and messages for five years

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise must keep records of its services and transactions that let BaFin check compliance with the conduct rules, MiFIR and the Market Abuse Regulation. For dealing on own account and for receiving, transmitting and executing client orders it must record the content of telephone calls and electronic communications, also where no transaction follows, keep the recordings for five years, then delete them and document the deletion.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Protect client money and hold it in segregated trust accounts
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 84 Abs. 1, 2 und 3a

titles.en: Protect client money and hold it in segregated trust accounts

summaries.en: A firm that holds client money must take suitable steps to protect clients' rights and to prevent the money being used for its own or another person's account without the client's express consent. Client money received in connection with a service must be placed without delay, separately from the firm's money and from other clients' money, in trust accounts with a deposit-taking credit institution, a central bank or, with the client's prior consent, a qualifying money market fund until it is used as agreed. These rules do not apply to client money that a firm licensed for deposit business holds as deposits under the Banking Act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use only competent and reliable staff for investment advice
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 87 Abs. 1

titles.en: Use only competent and reliable staff for investment advice

summaries.en: An investment services enterprise may entrust an employee with investment advice only if the employee has the necessary expertise and the reliability the activity requires.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the issuer and BaFin within four trading days when a voting rights threshold is crossed
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierhandelsgesetz (WpHG), BGBl. I S. 2708, § 33 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify the issuer and BaFin within four trading days when a voting rights threshold is crossed

summaries.en: Anyone whose voting rights in an issuer with Germany as home state reach, exceed or fall below 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 50 or 75 per cent, by acquisition, disposal or otherwise, must notify the issuer and at the same time BaFin without delay and within four trading days at the latest. The period runs from when the holder knows or ought to know of the threshold event, which is irrebuttably presumed two trading days after it at the latest.

instruments.title: Add WpIG, the German Investment Firms Act (Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, full text page with the Vollzitat, the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 9 G v. 9.4.2026 I Nr. 97) and the footnote on EU law; entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 8 Abs. 1 G v. 12.5.2021 I 990)

titles.de: Gesetz zur Beaufsichtigung von Wertpapierinstituten (Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz - WpIG)
titles.en: Act on the Supervision of Investment Firms (Investment Firms Act)

payload.implementsNote: MiFID II, Directive 2014/65/EU; EMIR 3 Directive, Directive (EU) 2024/2994 (the directives the act's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep sound governance with clear reporting lines, risk procedures, internal controls and gender-neutral pay
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 41

titles.en: Keep sound governance with clear reporting lines, risk procedures, internal controls and gender-neutral pay

summaries.en: An investment firm must have sound governance arrangements suited to the nature, scale and complexity of the risks in its business model and its business. They include a clear organisational structure with well-defined, transparent and consistent reporting lines, effective procedures to identify, assess, manage, monitor and communicate the risks it is exposed to or poses to others, adequate internal control mechanisms with proper administrative and accounting procedures, and a gender-neutral remuneration system consistent with sound risk management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Secure risk-bearing capacity and liquidity at all times in a medium-sized investment firm
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 39 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Secure risk-bearing capacity and liquidity at all times in a medium-sized investment firm

summaries.en: A medium-sized investment firm must secure its risk-bearing capacity on an ongoing basis, with procedures that rest on a prudent assessment of its risks and of the capital available to cover them, and must invest its funds so that sufficient liquidity is ensured at all times. The arrangements must be proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the business and be reviewed internally at regular intervals.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control material outsourcing and keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 40 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Control material outsourcing and keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements

summaries.en: An investment firm that outsources critical or important operational functions must take adequate precautions against excessive additional risk, and the outsourcing may impair neither the proper conduct of its services nor its business organisation or risk management. It must keep an outsourcing register of all material and non-material outsourcings, and where a material provider is based in a third country the contract must make it name an agent in Germany for service of documents by BaFin.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the managing directors own the risk strategy and receive full risk reporting
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 43

titles.en: Have the managing directors own the risk strategy and receive full risk reporting

summaries.en: The managing directors of an investment firm bear overall responsibility for its risk strategy and internal risk policies, and approve and regularly review the strategies and policies on risk appetite and on managing, monitoring and mitigating risks unless the supervisory body does so. They must devote enough time and provide enough resources, and the firm must ensure they learn of all significant risks and policy changes through internal reporting and have access to all risk information.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set up strategies and systems to control risks to clients, to the market and to the firm
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 45 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Set up strategies and systems to control risks to clients, to the market and to the firm

summaries.en: An investment firm must set up adequate strategies, policies, procedures and systems that identify, assess, manage, monitor and communicate its material risks and risk concentrations and their effect on own funds, covering risks to clients, to the market and to the firm, liquidity risks and concentration risk from exposures to central counterparties. When assessing risks to clients it must take account of segregated client money and examine whether professional indemnity insurance could reduce those risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep appropriate, transparent and sustainable pay systems for managers and risk takers
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 46 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Keep appropriate, transparent and sustainable pay systems for managers and risk takers

summaries.en: An investment firm must have remuneration systems for managing directors and for staff whose work materially affects the risk profile of the firm or of the assets it manages that are appropriate, transparent and geared to the firm's sustainable development, except where pay is set by collective agreement. A firm receiving extraordinary public financial support may pay its managing directors no variable remuneration and must limit other staff's variable pay where it is inconsistent with keeping the required own funds or with an early end to the support.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint managing directors who are qualified, reliable and have enough time
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 20 Abs. 1

titles.en: Appoint managing directors who are qualified, reliable and have enough time

summaries.en: The managing directors of a small or medium-sized investment firm must be professionally qualified and reliable and devote enough time to the role. Qualification requires sufficient theoretical and practical knowledge of the business and management experience, which is normally assumed after three years in a managing role at an investment firm of comparable size and type of business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in management, structure and holdings
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierinstitutsgesetz (WpIG), BGBl. I S. 990, § 64 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in management, structure and holdings

summaries.en: An investment firm must notify BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank without delay of, among other events, the completed appointment of a managing director or member of the supervisory body, a change of legal form, name or seat, branches and cross-border services in third countries, the end of business or an intended decision to dissolve, changes in qualifying holdings in the firm and in its own significant holdings, and every failure of a counterparty to a repurchase or securities lending transaction to perform.

instruments.title: Add KAGB, the German Capital Investment Code (Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, full text page with the Vollzitat, the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 3 G v. 9.4.2026 I Nr. 97) and the footnote on EU law; entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 28 Abs. 2 G v. 4.7.2013 I 1981)

titles.de: Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB)
titles.en: Capital Investment Code

payload.implementsNote: AIFMD II, Directive (EU) 2024/927; EMIR 3 Directive, Directive (EU) 2024/2994 (the directives the act's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act independently of the depositary and solely in the interest of investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 26 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Act independently of the depositary and solely in the interest of investors

summaries.en: A fund management company must act independently of the depositary and solely in the interest of investors. It must carry on its business honestly, fairly and with due skill, care and diligence, act in the best interests of the funds it manages, their investors and the integrity of the market, take all reasonable steps to avoid conflicts of interest or else to identify, manage, monitor and where appropriate disclose them, and treat all investors fairly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a proper business organisation with risk management, controls, records and a whistleblowing process
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 28 Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep a proper business organisation with risk management, controls, records and a whistleblowing process

summaries.en: A fund management company must have a business organisation that ensures compliance with the law. It includes an adequate risk management system, adequate staff and technical resources, rules on employees' personal transactions and on investing the company's own assets, control and security arrangements for data processing in line with DORA and the GDPR, complete documentation that lets every fund transaction be reconstructed, control procedures with an internal audit, proper administration and accounting, and a process for employees to report breaches confidentially.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an independent risk control function and review risk management at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 29 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Keep an independent risk control function and review risk management at least once a year

summaries.en: A fund management company must set up and maintain a permanent risk control function that is hierarchically and functionally independent of the operating units, or show that special safeguards against conflicts of interest allow independent risk control where full separation would be disproportionate. Its risk management systems must ensure that the material risks of each fund's investment strategy can be identified, measured, managed and monitored at all times, and must be reviewed at least once a year and adjusted where needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a liquidity management system and regular stress tests for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 30 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Run a liquidity management system and regular stress tests for each fund

summaries.en: A fund management company must have an adequate liquidity management system for each fund it manages, other than an unleveraged closed-ended fund, with procedures to monitor the fund's liquidity risks and to ensure the liquidity profile of its investments matches its underlying obligations. It must carry out regular stress tests under normal and exceptional liquidity conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Delegate functions only under the statutory conditions and keep effective oversight
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 36 Abs. 1

titles.en: Delegate functions only under the statutory conditions and keep effective oversight

summaries.en: A fund management company may delegate functions and services to another undertaking only under the conditions the section lists: it can justify its whole delegation structure on objective grounds, the delegate has sufficient resources and reliable, experienced managers, and portfolio or risk management goes only to firms authorised or registered for asset management and subject to supervision. Delegation must not impair supervision or acting in investors' interests, and the company must be able to show the delegate is qualified, capable and carefully chosen. It must secure by contract its rights to instruct and to terminate, be able to monitor the delegated functions effectively at all times and review the delegate's services continuously.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set a remuneration system for managers and risk takers that supports sound risk management
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 37 Abs. 1

titles.en: Set a remuneration system for managers and risk takers that supports sound risk management

summaries.en: A fund management company must set, for its managing directors, risk takers, staff in control functions and staff in the same pay bracket, a remuneration system that is consistent with and promotes sound and effective risk management, gives no incentive to take risks inconsistent with the risk profile or rules of the funds it manages, and does not hinder it in acting in the best interest of the fund.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify BaFin of material changes to the licence conditions before making them
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 34 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify BaFin of material changes to the licence conditions before making them

summaries.en: A fund management company must notify BaFin of all material changes to the conditions for its licence, in particular material changes to the information submitted with the licence application, before the change is put into effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report regularly to BaFin on markets, instruments, risks and assets of each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 35 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report regularly to BaFin on markets, instruments, risks and assets of each fund

summaries.en: A fund management company must inform BaFin regularly about the markets and instruments in which it trades for the funds it manages. For each fund it provides information on the instruments traded, the markets it is a member of or actively trades on, and the fund's risks and assets, with the identifiers needed to link the data to other supervisory or public sources.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a depositary for every UCITS under a contract in text form
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 68 Abs. 1

titles.en: Appoint a depositary for every UCITS under a contract in text form

summaries.en: A UCITS management company must ensure that a depositary is appointed for every UCITS it manages. The appointment is agreed in a contract in text form that governs, among other things, the exchange of information the depositary needs to perform its duties for the fund.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a retail investor in an AIF the prospectus, the latest reports and the current value before purchase
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (KAGB), BGBl. I S. 1981, § 297 Abs. 2

titles.en: Give a retail investor in an AIF the prospectus, the latest reports and the current value before purchase

summaries.en: A retail investor interested in buying a unit or share in an alternative investment fund must be informed before the contract of the fund's latest net asset value or the latest market price of the units or shares. The sales prospectus and the latest published annual and half-yearly reports must be made available free of charge in good time before the contract.

instruments.title: Add BörsG, the German Stock Exchange Act (Börsengesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Börsengesetz (BörsG), BGBl. I S. 1330, 1351, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 21 G v. 4.2.2026 I Nr. 33); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 14 Abs. 3 G v. 16.7.2007 I 1330)

titles.de: Börsengesetz (BörsG)
titles.en: Stock Exchange Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain admission before trading on an exchange and for each exchange trader
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Börsengesetz (BörsG), BGBl. I S. 1330, 1351, § 19 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Obtain admission before trading on an exchange and for each exchange trader

summaries.en: Taking part in exchange trading, and acting as an exchange trader for an admitted firm, requires admission by the management of the exchange. Only a firm that commercially buys and sells exchange-traded items for its own account, in its own name for others, or brokers such contracts, and whose business needs a commercially organised operation, may be admitted.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer for the orders of indirect trading participants given access to the exchange
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Börsengesetz (BörsG), BGBl. I S. 1330, 1351, § 19a

titles.en: Answer for the orders of indirect trading participants given access to the exchange

summaries.en: A trading participant is responsible for compliance with exchange law in respect of the orders of the indirect trading participants to which it gives access to the exchange.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Test trading algorithms in the environment the exchange provides
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Börsengesetz (BörsG), BGBl. I S. 1330, 1351, § 26d Abs. 2

titles.en: Test trading algorithms in the environment the exchange provides

summaries.en: Trading participants must test their algorithms in an environment made available by the exchange. The management of the exchange monitors compliance and reports indications of breaches to the exchange supervisory authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not induce inexperienced people to enter speculative exchange transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Börsengesetz (BörsG), BGBl. I S. 1330, 1351, § 26 Abs. 1

titles.en: Do not induce inexperienced people to enter speculative exchange transactions

summaries.en: It is prohibited to induce others commercially, by exploiting their inexperience in speculative exchange transactions, to enter into such transactions or to take part in them directly or indirectly.

instruments.title: Add WpPG, the German Securities Prospectus Act (Wertpapierprospektgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierprospektgesetz (WpPG), BGBl. I S. 1698, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 18 G v. 4.2.2026 I Nr. 33); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 10 G v. 22.6.2005 I 1698)

titles.de: Gesetz über die Erstellung, Billigung und Veröffentlichung des Prospekts, der beim öffentlichen Angebot von Wertpapieren oder bei der Zulassung von Wertpapieren zum Handel an einem organisierten Markt zu veröffentlichen ist (Wertpapierprospektgesetz - WpPG)
titles.en: Act on the Drawing Up, Approval and Publication of the Prospectus to be Published when Securities are Offered to the Public or Admitted to Trading on an Organised Market (Securities Prospectus Act)

payload.implementsNote: Supplements the Prospectus Regulation, Regulation (EU) 2017/1129, as § 1 of the act states

obligations.title: Add the duty: File and publish a securities information sheet before a public offer made without a prospectus
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierprospektgesetz (WpPG), BGBl. I S. 1698, § 4 Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: File and publish a securities information sheet before a public offer made without a prospectus

summaries.en: An offeror relying on the exemption in Article 3(2) of the Prospectus Regulation may offer the securities to the public in Germany only after drawing up a securities information sheet, depositing it with BaFin and publishing it. The sheet has at most three A4 pages and sets out, in a fixed order and in plain terms, the security and its rights, the offeror, issuer and any guarantor, the risks, the issuer's leverage, the prospects for repayment and returns, costs and commissions, the terms of the offer and the planned use of proceeds. The duty does not apply to offers below 100,000 euros over twelve months, to issuers whose shares are already admitted to a regulated market, to credit institutions, or where a PRIIPs key information document must be published.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the securities information sheet to BaFin electronically in a searchable format
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierprospektgesetz (WpPG), BGBl. I S. 1698, § 5 Abs. 1

titles.en: Send the securities information sheet to BaFin electronically in a searchable format

summaries.en: The securities information sheet must be sent to BaFin electronically and in an electronically searchable format through BaFin's reporting and publication system.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refer to the securities information sheet in advertising and mark advertising as such
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierprospektgesetz (WpPG), BGBl. I S. 1698, § 7 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Refer to the securities information sheet in advertising and mark advertising as such

summaries.en: For an offer that needs a securities information sheet, the offeror must ensure that advertising states that the sheet has been or will be published and where it can be obtained, and that the advertising is clearly recognisable as advertising.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take express responsibility for the prospectus, also as the bank applying for admission with the issuer
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Wertpapierprospektgesetz (WpPG), BGBl. I S. 1698, § 8

titles.en: Take express responsibility for the prospectus, also as the bank applying for admission with the issuer

summaries.en: At least the offeror, the issuer, the person applying for admission or the guarantor must expressly take responsibility for the content of a prospectus, and for a public offer the offeror must always do so. Where securities are to be admitted to trading on a regulated market on the basis of the prospectus, the credit institution, financial services institution or investment firm that applies for admission together with the issuer must take responsibility as well, as must any guarantor.

instruments.title: Add ZAG, the German Payment Services Supervision Act (Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl.
