I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 17 G v. 25.3.2026 I Nr. 81); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 15 Abs. 4 G v. 17.7.2017 I 2446)

titles.de: Gesetz über die Beaufsichtigung von Zahlungsdiensten (Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz - ZAG)
titles.en: Act on the Supervision of Payment Services (Payment Services Supervision Act)

payload.officialRef: Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz vom 17. Juli 2017 (BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 17 Abs. 1

titles.en: Safeguard the funds received from payment service users

summaries.en: An institution that provides payment services or issues e-money must safeguard the funds it has received from users or through another provider for payment transactions or for issuing e-money. It must either never mix them with other persons' funds and, where it still holds them at the end of the business day after receipt, place them in a separate account with a credit institution or a central bank or invest them in secure, liquid low-risk assets, or cover them by insurance or a comparable guarantee from an insurer or credit institution outside its own group. BaFin may prescribe which of the two methods is used.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a proper business organisation with risk management, internal audit and an IT contingency plan
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 27 Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep a proper business organisation with risk management, internal audit and an IT contingency plan

summaries.en: An institution must have a proper business organisation, for which its managing directors are responsible. It includes adequate governance, control mechanisms and procedures with appropriate and effective risk management that is reviewed regularly and an internal audit, a loss database and complete documentation of the business, an adequate contingency plan for IT systems, procedures to comply with Regulations (EU) 2021/1230, (EU) No 260/2012 and (EU) 2015/751 on interchange fees, and measures including data processing systems to meet the Money Laundering Act and the Funds Transfer Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control the outsourcing of material activities, ICT systems included
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 26 Abs. 1

titles.en: Control the outsourcing of material activities, ICT systems included

summaries.en: An institution that outsources activities or processes material to its payment services or e-money business, including ICT systems, must take adequate precautions against excessive additional risk and keep its risk management covering them. Responsibility stays with the managing directors and the institution, BaFin's and the auditors' rights of information and inspection must be secured, also for providers abroad, and each outsourcing needs a written agreement with the institution's rights to instruct and terminate. A material provider in a third country must name an agent in Germany for service of documents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank of each agent and wait for its entry in the register
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 25 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank of each agent and wait for its entry in the register

summaries.en: An institution that intends to provide payment services through an agent must send BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank the agent's name and address, a description of the agent's internal controls for meeting the Money Laundering Act, the names of its managers with proof that they are reliable and qualified, and the payment services entrusted to it. The agent may start providing payment services only once it is entered in the payment institutions register, and later changes must be notified.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in management and structure
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 28 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in management and structure

summaries.en: An institution must notify BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank without delay of, among other events, the intended appointment of a managing director with the facts needed to judge reliability, qualification and available time, the appointment and departure of members of the supervisory body, the departure of a managing director and a change of legal form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep all records for supervisory purposes for at least five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 30

titles.en: Keep all records for supervisory purposes for at least five years

summaries.en: Institutions must keep all records for supervisory purposes for at least five years, without prejudice to other statutory provisions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Control the operational and security risks of the payment services provided
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 53 Abs. 1

titles.en: Control the operational and security risks of the payment services provided

summaries.en: A payment service provider must set up, maintain and apply adequate risk mitigation measures and control mechanisms for the operational and security risks of the payment services it provides, including effective procedures for handling disruptions and for detecting and classifying major operational and security incidents. For payment institutions, e-money institutions and CRR credit institutions this applies without prejudice to Chapter II of DORA, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send BaFin an up-to-date assessment of operational and security risks once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 53 Abs. 2

titles.en: Send BaFin an up-to-date assessment of operational and security risks once a year

summaries.en: A payment service provider must send BaFin once a year a current and comprehensive assessment of the operational and security risks of the payment services it provides and of the adequacy of the mitigation measures and control mechanisms it has taken. BaFin may require the assessment at shorter intervals.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report a major operational or security incident to BaFin without delay and tell affected users
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 54 Abs. 1 und 4

titles.en: Report a major operational or security incident to BaFin without delay and tell affected users

summaries.en: A payment service provider must inform BaFin without delay of a major operational or security incident. Where the incident may affect the financial interests of its payment service users, it must notify them without delay and tell them of all measures they can take to limit the adverse effects.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Require strong customer authentication for online account access and electronic payments
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Zahlungsdiensteaufsichtsgesetz (ZAG), BGBl. I S. 2446; 2019 I S. 1113, § 55 Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Require strong customer authentication for online account access and electronic payments

summaries.en: A payment service provider must require strong customer authentication when the payer accesses the payment account online, initiates an electronic payment transaction or carries out a remote action that carries a risk of payment fraud or other abuse, and must protect the confidentiality and integrity of users' personalised security credentials. For electronic remote payments the authentication must dynamically link the transaction to a specific amount and payee, and the rules apply also when a payment initiation or account information service provider is used.

instruments.title: Add VAG, the German Insurance Supervision Act (Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, full text page with the Vollzitat, the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 2 G v. 25.9.2026 I Nr. 275, the change by Art. 3 shown in the text) and the footnote on EU law; entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 3 Abs. 1 Satz 1 G v. 1.4.2015 I 434)

titles.de: Gesetz über die Beaufsichtigung der Versicherungsunternehmen (Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz - VAG)
titles.en: Act on the Supervision of Insurance Undertakings (Insurance Supervision Act)

payload.implementsNote: Solvency II, Directive 2009/138/EC; CRD6, Directive (EU) 2024/1619 (the directives the act's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an effective business organisation with written policies approved by the board
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 23 Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: Keep an effective business organisation with written policies approved by the board

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must have a business organisation that is effective, proper and proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of its activities and that ensures compliance and sound and prudent management, with a transparent structure, clear and segregated responsibilities and effective internal communication. It must set written internal policies, approved in advance by the management board, at least on risk management, the internal control system, internal audit and outsourcing, and review them at least once a year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product approval process with a defined target market for every insurance product
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 23 Abs. 1a

titles.en: Run a product approval process with a defined target market for every insurance product

summaries.en: An undertaking that designs insurance products for sale must maintain, operate and regularly review a process for approving each product and each significant change to an existing one for distribution. The process must define a target market before the product is distributed, assess all risks relevant to that market and ensure that the intended distribution strategy fits it and that the product is distributed to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure those who run the insurer or hold key functions are reliable and qualified
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 24 Abs. 1

titles.en: Ensure those who run the insurer or hold key functions are reliable and qualified

summaries.en: Persons who effectively run an insurance undertaking or perform other key tasks must be reliable and professionally qualified. Qualification requires professional qualifications, knowledge and experience that ensure sound and prudent management, including adequate theoretical and practical knowledge of insurance business and, for management tasks, sufficient management experience.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run an effective risk management system integrated in the organisation
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 26 Abs. 1

titles.en: Run an effective risk management system integrated in the organisation

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must have an effective risk management system that is well integrated into its organisational structure and decision-making and serves the information needs of those who run it or hold key functions through adequate internal reporting. The system must cover the strategies, processes and internal reporting procedures needed to identify, assess, monitor, manage and report the risks the undertaking is or could be exposed to, individually and in aggregate. On the supervisor's request the undertaking must also draw up a recovery plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out the own risk and solvency assessment and report its result within 14 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 27 Abs. 1

titles.en: Carry out the own risk and solvency assessment and report its result within 14 days

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must carry out its own risk and solvency assessment regularly, and without delay when its risk profile changes materially, as a fixed part of its business strategy that feeds into strategic decisions. It must inform the supervisory authority of the result within 14 days of completing each assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an effective internal control system with a compliance function
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 29 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Keep an effective internal control system with a compliance function

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must have an effective internal control system that covers at least administrative and accounting procedures, an internal control framework and adequate internal reporting at all levels, and includes a compliance function. The compliance function advises the management board on compliance with the laws and administrative rules for insurance business, assesses the effect of changes in the legal environment and identifies and assesses compliance risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Stay responsible for outsourced functions and secure access for auditors and the supervisor
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 32 Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Stay responsible for outsourced functions and secure access for auditors and the supervisor

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking that outsources functions or insurance activities stays responsible for meeting all supervisory requirements, and outsourcing must not impair proper performance, the board's ability to steer and control, or the supervisor's rights. It must ensure that it, its auditors and the supervisory authority can access all data, that the service provider cooperates with the authority and that the authority has access to the provider's premises. For important functions it must also avoid material harm to the quality of its organisation, an undue rise in operational risk and any threat to continuous service to policyholders.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the supervisory authority without delay of changes in board, key persons and ownership
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 47

titles.en: Notify the supervisory authority without delay of changes in board, key persons and ownership

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must notify the supervisory authority without delay of, among other events, the appointment of a supervisory board member and the intended appointment of a managing director or other person responsible for key tasks, with the facts relevant to their qualification, the departure of any such person, amendments to the articles that increase capital, and the acquisition or disposal of a qualifying holding in the undertaking and the crossing of the 20, 30 and 50 per cent thresholds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Work only with authorised insurance intermediaries and keep sales staff qualified and reliable
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 48 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Work only with authorised insurance intermediaries and keep sales staff qualified and reliable

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking may work only with commercial insurance intermediaries that hold a licence under § 34d of the Trade Regulation Code, are exempt from it or do not need one, and that are authorised to receive policyholders' assets or have provided the required security. It must ensure that its employees directly or materially involved in distribution are reliable, have orderly finances, are adequately qualified for the insurance they sell and undergo regular further training.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish a solvency and financial condition report within 14 weeks of the financial year end
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsaufsichtsgesetz (VAG), BGBl. I S. 434, § 40 Abs. 1

titles.en: Publish a solvency and financial condition report within 14 weeks of the financial year end

summaries.en: An insurance undertaking must publish a solvency and financial condition report at least once a year and no later than 14 weeks after the end of the financial year, with six more weeks for a group report. The report must be approved by the management body before publication and sent to the supervisory authority without delay after it.

instruments.title: Add VVG, the German Insurance Contract Act (Versicherungsvertragsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 12 G v. 26.5.2026 I Nr. 156); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 12 Abs. 1 Satz 3 G v. 23.11.2007 I 2631)

titles.de: Gesetz über den Versicherungsvertrag (Versicherungsvertragsgesetz - VVG)
titles.en: Insurance Contract Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ask about the policyholder's wishes and needs, advise and document the advice
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 6 Abs. 1, 4 und 6

titles.en: Ask about the policyholder's wishes and needs, advise and document the advice

summaries.en: Before the insurance contract is concluded, the insurer must ask the policyholder about their wishes and needs where the difficulty of judging the insurance offered or the person and situation of the policyholder gives reason to, advise them in reasonable proportion to the premium, state the reasons for any advice given on a particular insurance, and document this. The duty continues during the contract where the insurer can see a reason to enquire and advise, and the policyholder may waive advice in the individual case by written declaration. It does not apply to contracts on large risks or where an insurance broker arranged the contract.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the policyholder the contract terms and required information in text form before they commit
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 7 Abs. 1

titles.en: Give the policyholder the contract terms and required information in text form before they commit

summaries.en: The insurer must give the policyholder its contract terms, including the general insurance conditions, and the information prescribed by regulation, in text form, clearly and comprehensibly, in good time before the policyholder makes their contractual declaration. Where the contract is concluded by telephone or another means that does not allow this at the policyholder's request, the information must be supplied without delay after conclusion.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the policyholder whether the parts of a package can be bought separately and what each costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 7a Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Tell the policyholder whether the parts of a package can be bought separately and what each costs

summaries.en: Where an insurance product is offered together with a non-insurance product or service as a package, the insurer must tell the policyholder whether the components can be bought separately and, if so, describe them and show the costs and charges of each separately. Where the cover in the package differs from that of the components bought separately, it must describe the components and how their interaction changes the cover.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give information on distribution, risks and all costs of an insurance-based investment product
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 7b Abs. 1

titles.en: Give information on distribution, risks and all costs of an insurance-based investment product

summaries.en: For insurance-based investment products the policyholder must be given, in good time before the contract is concluded, adequate information on the distribution of the product and on all costs and charges. It includes at least whether a periodic suitability assessment is offered where advice is given, suitable guidance and warnings on the risks of the products or proposed investment strategies, and information on the distribution, including the cost of advice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Recommend only insurance-based investment products that are suitable for the policyholder
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 7c Abs. 1

titles.en: Recommend only insurance-based investment products that are suitable for the policyholder

summaries.en: When advising on an insurance-based investment product the insurer must ask about the policyholder's knowledge and experience with the type of product or service, their financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and their investment objectives including risk tolerance. It may recommend only products that are suitable for the policyholder, and a bundled package only if the whole package is suitable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As insurance intermediary, ask about wishes and needs, advise, give reasons and document
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Versicherungsvertragsgesetz (VVG), BGBl. I S. 2631, § 61 Abs. 1

titles.en: As insurance intermediary, ask about wishes and needs, advise, give reasons and document

summaries.en: An insurance intermediary must ask the policyholder about their wishes and needs where the difficulty of judging the insurance offered or the person and situation of the policyholder gives reason to, advise them in reasonable proportion to the premium, and state the reasons for any advice given on a particular insurance. The intermediary must document this, taking account of the complexity of the contract offered, and under § 62 hand it over clearly and comprehensibly in text form before the contract is concluded.

instruments.title: Add GwG, the German Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 12 Abs. 4 G v. 29.6.2026 I Nr. 197); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 24 Satz 1 G v. 23.6.2017 I 1822)

titles.de: Gesetz über das Aufspüren von Gewinnen aus schweren Straftaten (Geldwäschegesetz - GwG)
titles.en: Act on the Detection of Proceeds from Serious Crimes (Money Laundering Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run effective AML risk management under a named member of management
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 4 Abs. 1 bis 3

titles.en: Run effective AML risk management under a named member of management

summaries.en: An obliged entity must have effective risk management against money laundering and terrorist financing that is appropriate to the nature and size of its business, made up of a risk analysis and internal safeguards. It must name a member of its management level who is responsible for risk management and for compliance with the AML rules, and who approves the risk analysis and the safeguards.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, assess and document the firm's money laundering and terrorist financing risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 5 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Identify, assess and document the firm's money laundering and terrorist financing risks

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify and assess the money laundering and terrorist financing risks of the business it conducts, taking account of the risk factors in Annexes 1 and 2 and of the national risk analysis. It must document the analysis, review it regularly, update it where needed and give the current version to the supervisory authority on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set up internal policies, procedures and controls against money laundering
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Set up internal policies, procedures and controls against money laundering

summaries.en: An obliged entity must create internal safeguards, as policies, procedures and controls suited to its own risk, monitor that they work and update them when needed. They include rules on handling risks, customer due diligence, reporting and record keeping, an AML officer, measures against the misuse of new products and technologies, reliability checks of staff, initial and ongoing staff training, and an independent review where the nature and size of the business call for one.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint an AML officer and a deputy and notify the supervisor in advance
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 7 Abs. 1, 4 und 5

titles.en: Appoint an AML officer and a deputy and notify the supervisor in advance

summaries.en: Credit institutions, financial services institutions, payment and e-money institutions, the insurers covered and the other obliged entities the section names must appoint an AML officer at management level and a deputy, placed directly below the managing board and reporting directly to it, and must notify the supervisory authority before appointing or releasing either. The officer must work in Germany, act as contact for law enforcement, the Financial Intelligence Unit and the supervisor, and be given sufficient powers, resources and unhindered access to all relevant information, and is not subject to management's instructions when filing a suspicious report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record due diligence data and keep it for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 8 Abs. 1 und 4

titles.en: Record due diligence data and keep it for five years

summaries.en: An obliged entity must record and keep the data and information gathered in customer due diligence on contracting parties, persons acting for them and beneficial owners, on business relationships and transactions, the risk assessments made and the reasons for its assessment of whether a matter had to be reported. The records are kept for five years from the end of the calendar year in which the business relationship ended or the information was established, unless another law sets a longer period, and are destroyed after ten years at the latest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply AML risk analysis and safeguards across the whole group
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 9 Abs. 1

titles.en: Apply AML risk analysis and safeguards across the whole group

summaries.en: An obliged entity that is the parent of a group must carry out a risk analysis for all branches and group companies subject to AML duties and, on that basis, set up uniform internal safeguards, appoint an AML officer responsible for a group-wide strategy, and create procedures for sharing information within the group and for protecting personal data. It must ensure these measures are put into effect by the branches and group companies under its controlling influence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out customer due diligence on new relationships and on larger occasional transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 10 Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: Carry out customer due diligence on new relationships and on larger occasional transactions

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify the contracting party and anyone acting for it, establish and identify any beneficial owner and the ownership and control structure, obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of the relationship, determine whether a politically exposed person is involved, and monitor the relationship and its transactions continuously, keeping its data up to date. These duties apply when a business relationship is established, to transfers of funds or crypto-assets of 1,000 euros or more and other transactions of 15,000 euros or more outside a relationship, whenever facts point to money laundering or terrorist financing, and when the identity data held is in doubt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify the customer and the beneficial owner before the relationship or transaction starts
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 11 Abs. 1

titles.en: Identify the customer and the beneficial owner before the relationship or transaction starts

summaries.en: An obliged entity must identify contracting parties, persons acting for them and beneficial owners before establishing the business relationship or carrying out the transaction, by collecting the required data and verifying it. Identification may be completed without delay while the relationship is being established only where this is needed to avoid interrupting normal business and the risk of money laundering and terrorist financing is low.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refuse or end the relationship when due diligence cannot be completed
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 10 Abs. 9

titles.en: Refuse or end the relationship when due diligence cannot be completed

summaries.en: Where an obliged entity cannot meet the general due diligence duties on identification, beneficial ownership, purpose of the relationship and politically exposed persons, it must not establish or continue the business relationship or carry out any transaction. An existing relationship must be ended by termination or otherwise, whatever other statutory or contractual provisions say.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk is higher
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 15 Abs. 2 bis 4

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence where the risk is higher

summaries.en: An obliged entity must apply enhanced due diligence, in addition to the general duties, where its risk analysis or the individual case shows a possibly higher risk, in particular with politically exposed persons, their family members and close associates, high-risk third countries, unusually complex, large or purposeless transactions, and cross-border correspondent relationships. In a higher-risk case and with politically exposed persons it must at least obtain the approval of a member of senior management to start or continue the relationship, take adequate steps to establish the source of the assets used, and monitor the relationship more closely.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report suspicions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 43 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report suspicions to the Financial Intelligence Unit without delay

summaries.en: Where facts indicate that an asset connected with a business relationship or transaction stems from a criminal offence that could be a predicate offence for money laundering, that a transaction or asset is connected with terrorist financing, or that the contracting party has not disclosed whether it acts for a beneficial owner, the obliged entity must report the matter without delay to the Financial Intelligence Unit (Zentralstelle für Finanztransaktionsuntersuchungen), whatever the value involved.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold a reported transaction until consent is given or three working days have passed
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 46 Abs. 1

titles.en: Hold a reported transaction until consent is given or three working days have passed

summaries.en: A transaction that has been reported under § 43 may be carried out at the earliest when the Financial Intelligence Unit or the public prosecutor has consented, or when the third working day after the day the report was sent has passed without either of them prohibiting it. Saturday does not count as a working day.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tell the customer or third parties about a suspicious report
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 47 Abs. 1

titles.en: Do not tell the customer or third parties about a suspicious report

summaries.en: An obliged entity must not inform the contracting party, the person ordering the transaction or other third parties of an intended or filed suspicious report, of an investigation opened because of such a report, or of a request for information from the Financial Intelligence Unit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report discrepancies in the transparency register to the registrar without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Geldwäschegesetz (GwG), BGBl. I S. 1822, § 23a Abs. 1

titles.en: Report discrepancies in the transparency register to the registrar without delay

summaries.en: An obliged entity that consults the transparency register must report to the body keeping the register, without delay, any discrepancy it finds between the beneficial ownership data accessible in the register and the data and knowledge it holds itself. A discrepancy exists where entries are missing, single details of the beneficial owners differ, or different beneficial owners were established.

instruments.title: Add AWG, the German Foreign Trade and Payments Act (Außenwirtschaftsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG), BGBl. I S. 1482, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 1 G v. 3.2.2026 I Nr. 27); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 4 Abs. 1 Satz 1 G v. 6.6.2013 I 1482)

titles.de: Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG)
titles.en: Foreign Trade and Payments Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not breach the prohibitions, freezing duties and licence requirements of EU sanctions regulations
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG), BGBl. I S. 1482, § 18 Abs. 1

titles.en: Do not breach the prohibitions, freezing duties and licence requirements of EU sanctions regulations

summaries.en: It is a criminal offence, punishable with three months to five years in prison, to breach a directly applicable EU act that carries out an economic sanctions measure of the Council. This covers acting against a prohibition on making funds or economic resources available, on providing financing, financial assistance, investment services or other financial services, failing a duty to prevent the movement, transfer, use of or access to frozen funds, circumventing such a duty by concealing assets or their owner, and acting without a required licence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Guard against negligent breaches of EU sanctions, which are administrative offences
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG), BGBl. I S. 1482, § 19 Abs. 1

titles.en: Guard against negligent breaches of EU sanctions, which are administrative offences

summaries.en: Anyone who negligently commits one of the acts listed in § 19 Abs. 1 by reference to § 18, among them breaches of EU sanctions prohibitions, freezing duties and licence requirements, commits an administrative offence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the customs office, the Bundesbank and BAFA information and business records on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsgesetz (AWG), BGBl. I S. 1482, § 23 Abs. 1 und 5

titles.en: Give the customs office, the Bundesbank and BAFA information and business records on request

summaries.en: The main customs office, the Deutsche Bundesbank, the Federal Office for Economic Affairs and Export Control (BAFA) and the Federal Office for Agriculture and Food may require the information needed to monitor compliance with this Act, the ordinances under it and EU foreign trade law, and may require business records to be produced. Everyone who takes part directly or indirectly in foreign trade and payments must provide it, including bodies to which such a person outsources tasks.

instruments.title: Add SanktDG, the German Sanctions Enforcement Act (Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz (SanktDG), BGBl. I S. 2606, full text page with the Vollzitat, which names no amending act; entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 26 Abs. 1 G v. 19.12.2022 I 2606)

titles.de: Gesetz zur Durchsetzung von wirtschaftlichen Sanktionsmaßnahmen (Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz - SanktDG)
titles.en: Act on the Enforcement of Economic Sanctions Measures (Sanctions Enforcement Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: As a sanctioned person, report funds and economic resources in Germany to the Central Office
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz (SanktDG), BGBl. I S. 2606, § 10 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: As a sanctioned person, report funds and economic resources in Germany to the Central Office

summaries.en: Unless an EU sanctions act already imposes a reporting duty, persons to whom no funds or economic resources may be made available under an EU sanctions regulation must report without delay to the Central Office for Sanctions Enforcement the funds and economic resources in Germany that they own, hold or control, and cooperate in checking the information. The report names the person and states the kind and value of the assets, and is not needed where a report was already made to the office under another provision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Central Office for Sanctions Enforcement the information and documents it demands
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz (SanktDG), BGBl. I S. 2606, § 2 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Give the Central Office for Sanctions Enforcement the information and documents it demands

summaries.en: To find the funds and economic resources in Germany of persons under an EU asset freeze and to monitor compliance with freezes and bans on making assets available, the Central Office for Sanctions Enforcement may demand information and the production of documents from natural and legal persons, partnerships and authorities where facts suggest they hold relevant details. It may also summon and question individuals and secure documents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept special monitoring ordered after a suspected breach of an asset freeze
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Sanktionsdurchsetzungsgesetz (SanktDG), BGBl. I S. 2606, § 9 Abs. 1

titles.en: Accept special monitoring ordered after a suspected breach of an asset freeze

summaries.en: Where facts justify the assumption that a legal person or partnership has breached, or is about to breach, a ban on making assets available or on disposing of them, the Central Office for Sanctions Enforcement may order special monitoring measures against it in writing. In particular it may demand information and documents from owners, employees and members of governing bodies, take part in meetings of those bodies and enter the business premises during normal hours.

instruments.title: Add BDSG, the German Federal Data Protection Act (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (zuletzt geändert durch Art. 3 G v. 12.5.2026 I Nr. 139, the change by Art. 3 G v. 3.7.2026 I Nr. 199 shown in the text); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 8 Abs. 1 Satz 1 G v. 30.6.2017 I 2097)

titles.de: Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG)
titles.en: Federal Data Protection Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a data protection officer once 20 people constantly process personal data by automated means
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, § 38 Abs. 1

titles.en: Appoint a data protection officer once 20 people constantly process personal data by automated means

summaries.en: In addition to the GDPR's cases, a controller and a processor must designate a data protection officer where they as a rule employ at least 20 persons constantly in the automated processing of personal data. Whatever the number of persons, an officer must be designated where processing requires a data protection impact assessment under Article 35 of the GDPR or personal data are processed commercially for transfer, anonymised transfer or market or opinion research.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use probability scores for contract decisions only on a recognised method and never on address data alone
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, § 31 Abs. 1

titles.en: Use probability scores for contract decisions only on a recognised method and never on address data alone

summaries.en: A probability value about a natural person's future behaviour may be used to decide on entering into, performing or ending a contract with that person only if data protection law was observed, the data used are demonstrably relevant under a scientifically recognised mathematical-statistical method, and the value was not calculated from address data alone. Where address data are used, the person must have been told of this beforehand and the notice documented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Rely on credit agency scores only where the unpaid claims behind them meet the statutory conditions
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, § 31 Abs. 2

titles.en: Rely on credit agency scores only where the unpaid claims behind them meet the statutory conditions

summaries.en: A probability value on a natural person's ability and willingness to pay that a credit reference agency has determined may be used, where it takes claims into account, only if the scoring conditions are met and only claims for a performance owed and not rendered when due are included that are established by judgment or enforceable title, were established in insolvency and not contested, were expressly acknowledged, were demanded in writing at least twice with the first reminder at least four weeks ago and the debtor told of the possible report and not contesting, or entitle the creditor to terminate without notice for arrears after such a warning.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process employees' personal data only as far as the employment relationship requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, § 26 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Process employees' personal data only as far as the employment relationship requires

summaries.en: Employees' personal data may be processed for employment purposes where this is necessary to decide on hiring, to carry out or end the employment, or to exercise rights and duties of employee representation. To uncover criminal offences they may be processed only where documented facts give rise to a suspicion that the person committed an offence in the employment, the processing is necessary and the employee's interests do not prevail. Consent must normally be given in writing or electronically, its voluntariness is judged in view of the employee's dependence, and the employer must explain the purpose and the right to withdraw in text form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use video surveillance of publicly accessible areas only where necessary and make it visible
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG), BGBl. I S. 2097, § 4 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Use video surveillance of publicly accessible areas only where necessary and make it visible

summaries.en: Publicly accessible areas may be monitored with video equipment only as far as this is necessary for public bodies to perform their tasks, to exercise the right to determine who may enter or to pursue legitimate interests for specifically defined purposes, and nothing indicates that the interests of the persons concerned prevail. The fact of the monitoring and the name and contact details of the controller must be made recognisable by suitable means at the earliest possible moment.

instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. titles.de: Gesetz zum automatischen Austausch von Informationen über Finanzkonten in Steuersachen (Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz - FKAustG)
titles.en: Act on the Automatic Exchange of Financial Account Information in Tax Matters (Financial Accounts Information Exchange Act)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable accounts to the Federal Central Tax Office by 31 July each year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. I S. 2531, § 27 Abs. 2

titles.en: Report reportable accounts to the Federal Central Tax Office by 31 July each year

summaries.en: Financial institutions must transmit the data on reportable accounts to the Federal Central Tax Office electronically, in the officially prescribed data set, by 31 July of each year for the previous calendar year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the holder, controlling persons, balance and income of each reportable account
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. I S. 2531, § 8 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report the holder, controlling persons, balance and income of each reportable account

summaries.en: For each reportable account a reporting financial institution must report the name, address, state or states of residence, tax identification number and date and place of birth of each reportable person who is an account holder or a controlling person of an entity, whether a valid self-certification was provided and whether the account is joint. It also reports the account number and type, whether the account is pre-existing or new, its own name and identification number, the balance or value at the end of the year or the closure of the account, and, among further details by type of account, for custodial accounts the gross interest, dividends and other income.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the CRS processes and the data checked and reported, and keep the records for ten years
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. I S. 2531, § 3 Abs. 3

titles.en: Record the CRS processes and the data checked and reported, and keep the records for ten years

summaries.en: A financial institution must record a description of the processes, including the technical, operational and organisational arrangements, it used to meet its reporting and due diligence duties for a reporting period, and for each account the information processed in due diligence with the time and result and the information reported with the time of the report. The records are kept for ten years from the end of the calendar year in which they were made, and the account records are then deleted if the contract has ended.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain and check a self-certification of tax residence when an individual opens an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. I S. 2531, § 13 Abs. 2

titles.en: Obtain and check a self-certification of tax residence when an individual opens an account

summaries.en: For a new account of a natural person the reporting financial institution must obtain, at account opening, a self-certification that lets it determine the account holder's tax residence or residences. It must confirm that the self-certification is plausible on the basis of the information it obtained at account opening, including the documents collected under anti-money laundering and know-your-customer procedures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Establish before opening an entity's account whether it or its controlling persons are reportable
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Finanzkonten-Informationsaustauschgesetz (FKAustG), BGBl. I S. 2531, § 16 Abs. 2

titles.en: Establish before opening an entity's account whether it or its controlling persons are reportable

summaries.en: For a new account of an entity the reporting financial institution must, before the account is opened, carry out review procedures to establish whether the account is held by reportable persons or by passive non-financial entities with controlling persons who are reportable. It obtains a self-certification that lets it determine the account holder's tax residence and confirms its plausibility against the information obtained at account opening, including anti-money laundering and know-your-customer documents.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Verify who is authorised on an account and who its beneficial owners are before opening it
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Abgabenordnung (AO), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 24, § 154 Abs. 2

titles.en: Verify who is authorised on an account and who its beneficial owners are before opening it

summaries.en: Anyone who keeps an account, holds valuables in custody or as a pledge, or lets a safe deposit box must first make certain of the identity and address of every person authorised to dispose and every beneficial owner within the meaning of the Money Laundering Act, and record these details in a suitable form, for accounts on the account. They must be able to tell the tax authorities at any time which accounts or boxes a person can dispose of, monitor the business relationship continuously and update the data at appropriate intervals.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Collect and record the tax identification numbers of account holders and beneficial owners
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Abgabenordnung (AO), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 24, § 154 Abs. 2a

titles.en: Collect and record the tax identification numbers of account holders and beneficial owners

summaries.en: A credit institution must collect and record, for every account holder, every other person authorised to dispose and every beneficial owner, the tax identification number and the business identification number or, where none has been issued to a non-natural person, the tax number used for income taxation. This does not apply to credit accounts where the credit only finances private consumer goods and the limit does not exceed 12,000 euros.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open no account in a false or invented name and release blocked assets only with the tax office's consent
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Abgabenordnung (AO), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 24, § 154 Abs. 1 und 3

titles.en: Open no account in a false or invented name and release blocked assets only with the tax office's consent

summaries.en: Nobody may open an account, have entries made, deposit or pledge valuables or obtain a safe deposit box under a false or invented name, for themselves or for a third party. Where this was breached, balances, valuables and the contents of a safe deposit box may be released only with the consent of the tax office responsible for the income tax of the person authorised to dispose.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cross-border tax arrangements to the Federal Central Tax Office as intermediary
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Abgabenordnung (AO), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 24, § 138d Abs. 1

titles.en: Report cross-border tax arrangements to the Federal Central Tax Office as intermediary

summaries.en: Anyone who markets a reportable cross-border tax arrangement, designs it for third parties, organises it, makes it available for use or manages its implementation by third parties is an intermediary and must report the arrangement to the Federal Central Tax Office under §§ 138f and 138h.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the report on a cross-border tax arrangement within 30 days through the official interface
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Abgabenordnung (AO), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 24, § 138f Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: File the report on a cross-border tax arrangement within 30 days through the official interface

summaries.en: The intermediary must report the cross-border tax arrangement to the Federal Central Tax Office in the officially prescribed data set through the official interface. The details are to be sent within 30 days after the day on which the first of these events occurs: the arrangement is made available for implementation, the user is ready to implement it, or at least one user has taken the first step of implementation.

titles.de: Gesetz zur Aufsicht über Märkte für Kryptowerte (Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetz - KMAG)
titles.en: Act on the Supervision of Markets in Crypto-Assets (Crypto Markets Supervision Act)

payload.officialRef: Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetz vom 27. Dezember 2024 (BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 438, S. 2)
payload.implementsNote: Supplements MiCA, Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, as § 1 of the act states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in structure, capital and ownership
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetz (KMAG), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 438, S. 2, § 21 Abs. 1

titles.en: Notify BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay of changes in structure, capital and ownership

summaries.en: An institution under the act must notify BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank without delay of, among other events, a change of legal form or name, a loss of 25 per cent of own funds, a move of its establishment or seat, the start and end of cross-border services, an intended decision to dissolve, initial capital falling below the minimum under MiCA or the loss of suitable insurance, changes in qualifying holdings in the institution at the 20, 30 and 50 per cent thresholds, and close links.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send inside information to BaFin without delay after publishing it
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetz (KMAG), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 438, S. 2, § 36 Abs. 1

titles.en: Send inside information to BaFin without delay after publishing it

summaries.en: An issuer, offeror or person seeking admission to trading that must publish inside information under Article 88(1) of MiCA and has Germany as its home member state must send that inside information to BaFin without delay after publication.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the annual accounts and management report to BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kryptomärkteaufsichtsgesetz (KMAG), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 438, S. 2, § 38 Abs. 1

titles.en: Submit the annual accounts and management report to BaFin and the Bundesbank without delay

summaries.en: An institution subject to the accounting duty in § 37 must submit its annual accounts as drawn up and later as adopted, with the management report, to BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank without delay in each case. The accounts must carry the audit opinion or a note that it was refused, and the auditor submits the audit report to both without delay after the audit ends.

instruments.title: Add KI-MIG, the German act carrying out the EU AI Act
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, KI-Marktüberwachungs-und-Innovationsförderungs-Gesetz (KI-MIG), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 223, full text page with the Vollzitat, which names no amending act; entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 5 G v. 22.7.2026 I Nr. 223)

titles.de: Gesetz zur Marktüberwachung und Innovationsförderung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI-Marktüberwachungs-und-Innovationsförderungs-Gesetz - KI-MIG)
titles.en: Act on Market Surveillance and the Promotion of Innovation in Artificial Intelligence

payload.implementsNote: Supplements the AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as § 1 of the act states

obligations.title: Add the duty: Submit the plan for a real-world test of a high-risk AI system to the market surveillance authority first
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, KI-Marktüberwachungs-und-Innovationsförderungs-Gesetz (KI-MIG), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 223, § 14 Abs. 2

titles.en: Submit the plan for a real-world test of a high-risk AI system to the market surveillance authority first

summaries.en: Before a provider or prospective provider tests a high-risk AI system listed in Annex I Section A or Annex III of the AI Act in real-world conditions, alone or with deployers, it must submit the test plan to the competent market surveillance authority, and the test must take place before the system is placed on the market or put into service. The authority approves the test and the plan where Article 60(4) of the AI Act is met, and approval is deemed given if no reply arrives within 30 days of receipt of the plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the AI Act duties on information, access and the fundamental rights impact assessment, which carry fines
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, KI-Marktüberwachungs-und-Innovationsförderungs-Gesetz (KI-MIG), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 223, § 15 Abs. 1

titles.en: Meet the AI Act duties on information, access and the fundamental rights impact assessment, which carry fines

summaries.en: It is an administrative offence to breach the AI Act, intentionally or negligently, by among other acts failing to transmit the information or documentation named in Article 21(1) correctly, completely and in time, refusing access against Article 21(2), failing to carry out the fundamental rights impact assessment named in Article 27(1) correctly, completely and in time or to update the information under Article 27(2), or failing to send the notification named in Article 27(3).

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry the AI Act retention duty over to the liquidator when a provider ceases business
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, KI-Marktüberwachungs-und-Innovationsförderungs-Gesetz (KI-MIG), BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 223, § 18

titles.en: Carry the AI Act retention duty over to the liquidator when a provider ceases business

summaries.en: Where a provider of an AI system, or an authorised representative established in Germany, ceases its business, the person responsible for liquidating or dissolving the legal person bears the retention duty under Article 18(1) of the AI Act.

instruments.title: Add KrZwMG, the German Secondary Credit Market Act (Kreditzweitmarktgesetz)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (geändert durch Art. 20 G v. 25.3.2026 I Nr. 81); entry into force read in the page's footnote (Art. 36 Abs. 1 G v. 22.12.2023 I Nr. 411)

titles.de: Gesetz über den Zweitmarkt für notleidende Kredite und über Kreditdienstleistungsinstitute (Kreditzweitmarktgesetz - KrZwMG)
titles.en: Act on the Secondary Market for Non-Performing Loans and on Credit Servicing Institutions (Secondary Credit Market Act)

payload.officialRef: Kreditzweitmarktgesetz vom 22. Dezember 2023 (BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2)
payload.implementsNote: Credit Servicers Directive, Directive (EU) 2021/2167 (the footnote to the enacting act in the Bundesgesetzblatt, BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a prospective purchaser the data needed to value a non-performing loan
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 6 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Give a prospective purchaser the data needed to value a non-performing loan

summaries.en: Before agreeing to sell a non-performing credit agreement or the creditor's claims under it, a credit institution must give the prospective purchaser the information on the agreement or claims and on any collateral that the purchaser needs to assess their value and the likelihood of recovering it. The information is transmitted in the form set by the implementing technical standards under Article 16 of Directive (EU) 2021/2167, also for transfers between credit institutions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report transfers of non-performing loans to the supervisors every six months
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 6 Abs. 3

titles.en: Report transfers of non-performing loans to the supervisors every six months

summaries.en: A credit institution that transfers non-performing credit agreements or claims to a credit purchaser must report every six months, for the transfers since its last report, at least the purchaser's legal entity identifier or name and address, the aggregate outstanding amount, the number and volume of the agreements or claims transferred, and whether consumer loans are included and how the loans are secured. The report goes to BaFin and the Deutsche Bundesbank, or to the European Central Bank where it supervises the institution, and to any host member state authority.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain BaFin's licence before providing credit servicing commercially in Germany
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 10 Abs. 1

titles.en: Obtain BaFin's licence before providing credit servicing commercially in Germany

summaries.en: Anyone who wants to provide credit servicing in Germany commercially, or on a scale that requires a commercially organised business, needs the written or electronic licence of BaFin, except in the cases of §§ 11 and 23.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a proper business organisation in a credit servicing institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 14 Abs. 1

titles.en: Keep a proper business organisation in a credit servicing institution

summaries.en: A credit servicing institution must have a proper business organisation that ensures compliance with the law and with sound business needs. Its managing directors are responsible for it and must take the steps needed to draw up the internal rules, unless the supervisory body decides.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat borrowers fairly, inform them truthfully and exert no undue pressure
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 28 Abs. 1

titles.en: Treat borrowers fairly, inform them truthfully and exert no undue pressure

summaries.en: In their dealings with borrowers, credit purchasers and credit servicers must act in good faith and with regard to accepted practice, give only information that is correct and comprehensible, and respect and protect borrowers' personal data and right to confidentiality. They must not influence borrowers unduly, in particular through harassment, unlawful pressure or coercion that impairs the borrower's freedom of decision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the borrower about the transfer before the first enforcement step
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kreditzweitmarktgesetz (KrZwMG), BGBl. 2023 I Nr. 411, S. 2, § 30 Abs. 1

titles.en: Tell the borrower about the transfer before the first enforcement step

summaries.en: After a non-performing credit agreement or claims under it have passed to a credit purchaser, the purchaser or the credit servicer must tell the borrower in text form, clearly and comprehensibly, before the first enforcement measure and whenever the borrower asks, at least that and when the transfer took place, the name and contact details of the purchaser, of any credit servicer and of any outsourcing provider, proof of a credit servicing institution's licence, and a contact person. The notice also states the amounts the borrower owes, broken down into outstanding credit, interest, fees and other permitted claims, that all relevant law continues to apply after the transfer, and which authorities take the borrower's complaints.
